name: Human
flavor: Adaptable and hardy, but unremarkable against magic.

name: Elf
flavor: Gifted in magic, yet frail of body.

name: Dwarf
flavor: Sturdy and armored, but slow to move.

name: Halfling
flavor: Nimble and quick, though they lack raw strength.

name: Goblin
flavor: Skittering raiders, fast but poorly armored.

name: Hobgoblin
flavor: Disciplined goblinoids in heavier kit.

name: Orc
flavor: Brutal warriors with little guard against spells.

name: Ogre
flavor: Lumbering brutes that hit like a battering ram.

name: Minotaur
flavor: Massive bull-men, hard to fell and slow to turn.

name: Troll
flavor: Hulking regenerators weak to elemental harm.

name: Kobold
flavor: Scurrying trap-makers, quick but fragile.

name: Gnoll
flavor: Frenzied hyena-folk of savage ferocity.

name: Lizardfolk
flavor: Scaled and tough, dull to the arcane.

name: Naga
flavor: Serpentine sorcerers, sinuous but ground-bound.

name: Merfolk
flavor: Tide-touched and ward-strong, lightly armored.

name: Bat
flavor: Darting fliers with paper-thin frames.

name: Wolf
flavor: Pack hunters, swift but exposed to magic.

name: Dire Beast
flavor: Oversized predators of brute instinct.

name: Spider
flavor: Venomous skitterers of fragile resolve.

name: Insectoid
flavor: Chittering swarmers, fast but feeble strikers.

name: Slime
flavor: Gelatinous oozes that shrug off spells and creep.

name: Skeleton
flavor: Animated bones, rigid yet brittle to disruption.

name: Zombie
flavor: Shambling undead, durable but witless.

name: Wraith
flavor: Spectral casters, potent but barely corporeal.

name: Imp
flavor: Mischievous fiends crackling with frail magic.

name: Demon
flavor: Infernal channelers of reckless power.

name: Gargoyle
flavor: Stone sentinels, armored and arcane-numb.

name: Golem
flavor: Constructed titans, immense but spell-blind.

name: Harpy
flavor: Screeching raptors that strike from the air.

name: Treant
flavor: Ancient walking trees, rooted and resolute.

name: Elemental
flavor: Living energy, mighty in magic, unstable in form.

name: Drake
flavor: Lesser dragonkin of great vigor and small mind.
